:::{#exr-sxx-expand}
#### Expanding the centered sum of squares

Expand the centered sum of squares $\sspred$ (@def-centered-sums)
into an expression in terms of $n$, $\sumin \predvar_\iobs^2$ and $\predbar$.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-sxx-expand}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\sspred
&= \sumin (\predvar_\iobs - \predbar)^2
&& \text{(definition of $\sspred$)}\\
&= \sumin \paren{\predvar_\iobs^2 - 2 \predbar \predvar_\iobs + \predbar^2}
&& \text{(expand the square)}\\
&= \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 - \sumin 2 \predbar \predvar_\iobs + \sumin \predbar^2
&& \text{(distribute the sum over the terms)}\\
&= \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 - 2 \predbar \sumin \predvar_\iobs + \sumin \predbar^2
&& \text{(constant factor out of the sum)}\\
&= \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 - 2 \predbar \sumin \predvar_\iobs + n \predbar^2
&& \text{(sum of a constant)}\\
&= \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 - 2 \predbar \cdot n \predbar + n \predbar^2
&& \text{($\sumin \predvar_\iobs = n \predbar$)}\\
&= \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 - 2 n \predbar^2 + n \predbar^2
&& \text{(multiply)}\\
&= \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 - n \predbar^2
&& \text{(collect the $\predbar^2$ terms)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
